overview: The Medford School Committee met to ratify collective bargaining agreements, approve a modified late-entry schedule pilot for MCAS testing days, and review enrollment and revenue projections for the upcoming fiscal year 2027 budget.

items.title: Executive Session & Cafeteria Workers Contract Ratification
items.summary: The committee entered executive session to discuss collective bargaining and subsequently ratified the contract with the Medford School Cafeteria workers.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved bills, payrolls, budget transfers, donations, and the March 2, 2026 meeting minutes.

items.title: Winter Sports Recognition
items.summary: The committee and athletic staff recognized the achievements of winter sport athletes, Greater Boston League champions, and GBL All-Stars.

items.title: MCAS Flex Pilot Program
items.summary: Approved a pilot program implementing a late-entry schedule for non-testing high school students during 10th-grade math MCAS testing days in May 2026.

items.title: Enrollment and Revenue Projections for FY27 Budget
items.summary: Received a financial update detailing declining enrollment trends, projected state aid, special revenue funds, and anticipated cost increases for the upcoming budget process.

items.title: Resolution on Extreme Cold Temperature Mitigation
items.summary: Approved a resolution directing the school district to create a cold-weather mitigation and activity relocation plan.

items.title: Resolution on Strategic Planning Subcommittee
items.summary: Approved a resolution directing the strategic planning subcommittee to convene and establish a timeline and deliverables for a new community-informed strategic plan.
